title: GUidance In Prostate Cancer DEtection With 18F-PSMA-1007-PET/MRI and Targeted Biopsies
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:

* PSAdensity \> 0.20
* Negative MRI (PI-RADS 1-2) or negative biopsy from MRI-target
* MRI within 6 months
* Read and understand danish
* Expected remaining lifetime \> 10 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known prostate cancer
* MRI contraindications
